title: HR Audit & Labour Compliance Vacancy At Baroda Global Shared Services Limited (BGSSS)
description: Baroda Global Shared Services Limited (BGSSS) invites online application for the post of HR Audit & Labour Compliance. Name of the Post: HR Audit & Labour Compliance Location: Gift City, Gandhinagar. Essential Qualification and Experience LL.B. with specialization in Labour Law, OR MBA – Finance / HR / Legal from a reputed institution with 10-15 years of experience. Additional certifications in Labour Law, Compliance Management, or Internal Auditing preferred. Deep knowledge of Indian Labour Law
